The '''Crescent Canyon Research Station''' was a research station that was part of the [[Crescent Canyon Facility]], a research facility built atop the [[Crescent Canyon Mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. It was eventually abandoned by Czerka but occupied by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colonists, and was later conquered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
